::::{#thm-smoothing-spline-zero-penalty}

#### Smoothing spline with no penalty interpolates the training data

Let $(x_1, y_1), \ldots, (x_n, y_n)$ be data with distinct values $x_i$,
and let $\est{g}_\l$ be the smoothing spline of @thm-smoothing-spline-large-penalty.
As $\l \to 0$, $\est{g}_\l$ approaches a function that interpolates every training point,
$g(x_i) = y_i$ for all $i$,
so the training residual sum of squares $\sumin (y_i - \est{g}_\l(x_i))^2$ approaches $0$.

::::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-smoothing-penalty.

:::
